summary: All 140 cases now have a result. The page, lists, counts, permissions, comments, reminders, reassign, decide-on-behalf, bulk actions, overdue and escalation, web form hold, Arabic and ticket-side approvals work. Open: one serious blueprint approval bug, a reject-reason bug, a blueprint cancel bug, and gaps in filters, reports, detail fields and keyboard use.

items.title: Blueprint approval step does not hold the transition
items.text: Running a transition that has a "Submit for approval" step moves the ticket to the target state and runs the after-transition actions at once, before anyone decides. Approving then changes nothing. Rejecting leaves the ticket in the target state with the after-actions applied, and the requester cannot run the transition again (409 state changed). Expected: the ticket waits in its current state; approve completes the move and runs the after-actions; reject keeps it where it was. Seen on QA PA bp 7 and bp 8 (On Hold -> Escalated).

items.title: Ticket approval can be rejected without a reason
items.text: The single Reject dialog labels the field "Comment (optional)" and Reject stays enabled when it is empty, 2 characters or spaces. The API also accepts no comment, null, "", "ab" or spaces and rejects the request. Bulk reject and on-behalf reject do require 3 to 2000 characters. Requirement PA-ACT-2: a reason of 3 to 2000 characters is required.

items.title: Requester can cancel a blueprint approval
items.text: Blueprint items in Requested by me show "Cancel request" and the cancel call returns 200. PA-ACT-6: blueprint items end only by revoking the transition on the ticket (the page even has a message for this case).

items.title: Agent can choose any approver when running a blueprint approval step
items.text: The step is set up with approver B, but the run accepted approver D instead (approval saved with D). The step's approvers are not enforced.

items.title: Web form reject reason allows 1 to 1000 characters
items.text: "ab" is accepted for a web form rejection; the requirement and ticket approvals use 3 to 2000.

items.title: Missing filters and sort
items.text: Built: source, department, waiting (over 4 h, 1 day, 3 days, overdue), search; sort by request time, ticket number, department. Not built: filters by requested by, approver, request date range, blueprint, web form, ticket priority; sort by requester.

items.title: No approvals report
items.text: No report by source, status, department or approver, and no time-to-decide figure.

items.title: Details and rows miss requested fields
items.text: Rows lack contact name/email, requester and waiting duration. Ticket summary lacks owner, contact, channel, created time, SLA due, last 2 messages. Web form details lack the submitted field values, spam signals, attachments and the duplicate hint. Blueprint details lack the transition name, the values entered and what approve/reject will do.

items.title: No next / previous in details
items.text: With an item open there is no keyboard shortcut or button to move to the next or previous item.

items.title: Decided list is ordered by request time
items.text: Decided shows newest request first, not newest decision first.

items.title: Keyboard and Arabic details
items.text: Keyboard only works but takes 41-42 Tab presses to reach the first row; dialogs open with focus on the buttons, not the comment/reason box; after approving or rejecting, focus drops to the page body. In Arabic, a YYYY-MM-DD date in Arabic digits is reordered by the right-to-left text. Approval notifications are translated in the bell, but the "Ticket ... was escalated" notice and the "HELD SUBMISSION" chip stay in English.

items.title: What this run could not check
items.text: Email content and language (no mailbox), attachments on held submissions, 30-day expiry, double opt-in forms, 99+ count, live count refresh, remembered view after sign-out, and speed at volume (network noise from this PC made timings unusable).
